definitions.Snap: Instant arrival with no visible travel. The limb is here, then there. Used on every light.
definitions.Whip: The tip travels last and fastest — cards, coat, dreads. The body is the handle.
definitions.Shuffle: Feet moving more than the situation requires. Rhythm for its own sake.
definitions.Fake: A committed motion that stops and becomes another. Every heavy should threaten to be a fake.
definitions.Flow: One motion melts into the next without a settle. He never stops between actions.
definitions.Flourish: An unnecessary decorative beat added at the END of a move. This is his signature.
definitions.Slide: Low, frictionless travel. Weight barely on the floor.

verbs.note: Brooklyn never braces. If a pose requires him to hold ground, he is off-model.

emotionalIntent: Amusement escalating to delight. He is enjoying this more than you are.

ai._derivedFrom: Character DNA — do not hand-edit. Edit DNA and re-derive.

idle.style: weight rolling hip to hip, showy

comboRhythm.note: links land exactly on the beat
